about_the_game:
After a fatal car crash, you awaken alone on a dark, desolate road. The person you hit has vanished without a trace, and a mysterious house looms nearby. Something isn’t right. As you explore, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur.

Welcome to a chilling Survival Horror experience, where every step you take puts you closer to the edge of sanity. With a unique visual style that blends eerie realism with haunting abstraction, you’ll navigate a world where danger is never far behind and your only hope of survival is your own wits.

Key Features

🕯️ Survival
You’re vulnerable. Use your wits, explore your surroundings, and craft tools to fend off threats and solve environmental challenges. Every decision matters as you struggle to stay alive.

🏚️ Safehouses Aren’t Always Safe
Find temporary refuge to gather your strength, craft items, and rest… but beware—safehouses become unsafe as you progress, with new horrors emerging once you think you're safe.

🔦 Unlock Tools to Survive
Start with only a flashlight. As you advance, unlock powerful tools like night vision, masks, and more to aid your survival. The deeper you go, the more tools you’ll need to survive the escalating danger.

🧩 Explore and Solve Puzzles
Search for clues, gather items, and uncover horrifying secrets hidden throughout the world. The environment is full of puzzles that will reveal pieces of a terrifying story.

🌫️ Psychological Horror
As you delve deeper, your mind begins to distort. Poison and terror twist your vision, making it harder to tell what’s real and what’s a nightmare. The line between the two becomes thinner with every passing moment.

🐀 Environmental Threats
Survive rat swarms, navigate creepy basements, and escape unseen dangers that lurk just out of sight. The environment itself is a constant threat, changing as you progress.

🎭 Immersive Atmosphere
Stylized yet haunting visuals create an immersive, tension-filled atmosphere that keeps you on edge from start to finish. The world around you is as much of an enemy as the creatures stalking the shadows.

🔒 Unlockable Abilities
Unlock unique skills and tools as you progress. With each new ability, you gain a greater chance of survival, but the horrors you face will grow ever more dangerous.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or macOS 11.0 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 280X with 4 GB VRAM or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or macOS 11.0 or later
  • Processor: 6-core Intel i7 or AMD Ryzen 5 processor
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (or better) with 6-8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Dedicated sound card or motherboard with high-quality audio support
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No
